title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

providers.name: ServiceNow
providers.scope_notes: Release/plugin dependent. API key/HMAC requires com.glide.tokenbased_auth and API-specific policy. Documentation reviewed is Brazil.

controls.name: REST API access policy
controls.what: Per REST API (or globally), lists the inbound authentication profiles allowed, so unlisted credential types such as Basic are refused.
controls.setting: All > System Web Services > REST API Access Policies (map Inbound Authentication Profiles)
controls.quote: Create an API access policy and map an authentication profile to restrict the authentication type for a REST API.

controls.name: API access policy with adaptive authentication filter criteria (IP)
controls.what: An access policy can combine an allowed auth type with filter criteria such as an IP range; other auth types or IPs are denied.
controls.setting: REST API Access Policies + Adaptive Authentication filter criteria
controls.quote: allows only OAuth 2.0 authentication type from a specified range of IP addresses

controls.name: Adaptive authentication policies
controls.what: Allows or denies authentication by IP address, role or group, including for inbound REST API requests.
controls.setting: All > Adaptive Authentication > Authentication Policies / Filter Criteria
controls.quote: You can use the filter criteria of adaptive authentication framework to restrict access to inbound ServiceNow REST APIs.

controls.name: IP Address Access Control
controls.what: Instance-wide allow/deny IP rules for inbound traffic regardless of credential type.
controls.setting: All > System Security > IP Address Access Control (plugin com.snc.ipauthenticator)
controls.quote: Deny: Any IP address in this range cannot interact with this instance unless it is listed in an Allow rule.

controls.name: REST API Auth Scope
controls.what: Once an API has an auth scope, only OAuth entities (or API keys) carrying that scope can call it; the useraccount scope bypasses this.
controls.setting: System Web Services > REST API Auth Scope; link scope to OAuth entity / REST API Key
controls.quote: you must associate the same Auth Scope to the OAuth Entity which should have access to this REST API.

controls.name: REST API Key: Expiry, Active, Auth Scope
controls.what: Each API key can be deactivated, given an expiry (empty means never) and limited by auth scope.
controls.setting: All > System Web Services > API Access Policies > REST API Key
controls.quote: Time after which the credential is no longer valid. Empty value means no expiration.

controls.name: API key / HMAC require a specific API access policy
controls.what: Token-based auth works only on APIs where an access policy lists the API key or HMAC profile; it cannot be added to the global policy.
controls.setting: REST API Access Policies > add API Key / HMAC authentication profile
controls.quote: Token Based Auth isn't allowed in the Global REST API Policy.

controls.name: api_service_admin role (API key / HMAC configuration)
controls.what: Creating API keys and HMAC secrets requires the api_service_admin and adaptive_auth_policy_admin roles; users without them cannot create these credentials.

controls_unknown: Which authentication types the default Global REST API policy allows; the Brazil page names the Global Blocking Policy but does not list them.

authentication.summary: Basic username/password; API key/HMAC via plugin; OAuth bearer including code + PKCE, client credentials and Third-Party ID Token Flow.

federation.details: Inbound Third-Party ID Token Flow trusts external providers such as Entra or Okta, subject to configured trust.

ip_restriction.boundary: REST API access policies can allow only selected authentication types and source IP ranges.

renewal.summary: The same API key is reused until its optional expiry; a blank expiry means no expiration. Deactivate the key record to revoke.

administration.summary: Roles/ACLs, REST auth scopes, API access policies and OAuth client restrictions. Enable token restrictions to associate tokens with permitted APIs.
administration.conditions: Release/plugin dependent. API key/HMAC requires com.glide.tokenbased_auth and API-specific policy. Documentation reviewed is Brazil.

inventory.details: All > System Web Services > API Access Policies > REST API Key lists the instance's API keys.

reads.ui: All > System Logs > Transactions; filter Created by = the integration user, then URL (e.g. the REST path called)

token_format.notes: Sent as x-sn-apikey header or query parameter; optional configurable prefix; no GitHub pattern listed.

log_sources.name: Transaction log (System Logs > Transactions)
log_sources.notes: Records requests with Created by, URL, IP address, HTTP Response Code. Retention not stated in docs.

log_sources.name: REST API Key records (API Access Policies > REST API Key)
log_sources.notes: Key with User, Active, Expiry, Auth Scope. Plugin com.glide.tokenbased_auth.

anomaly_cues: Keys with empty Expiry tied to admin users
API key passed as query parameter (leaks into proxies and logs)
Key's user making calls outside the scoped APIs
New REST API Key created outside change process

containment.steps: Set the REST API Key Active to false or delete it; lock or deactivate the key's user; tighten REST API access policy.
containment.notes: Each request presents the key, so deactivation should stop use; not confirmed in docs.

sample_query.query: System Logs > Transactions: Created by = svc.apikey ^ Created in Last 7 days ^ IP address NOT IN <known integration egress IPs>
sample_query.purpose: Find calls by an API key's user from unexpected IPs

unknown: Transaction log table/column names (only UI labels fetched)
Whether key ID is logged per request

calls.reveals: Confirms the API key maps to a user and that user's read reach; identity behind the key
calls.scope: REST API key tied to a user; read ACL on sys_user
calls.log_notes: Request logged with Created by = associated user, URL, IP. API key auth requires API Key and HMAC Authentication plugin

calls.reveals: Table/schema inventory accessible to the key's user
Bulk record data from readable tables
calls.scope: read ACL on target table (REST API Access Policy may apply)
calls.log_notes: Each Table API GET logged; retention ~56 days default

calls.reveals: Aggregate counts/sums grouped by field; sizing data without pulling all rows
calls.scope: read access to the table (GlideAggregate honors ACL)
calls.log_notes: Aggregate GET logged as a transaction

unknown: Whether REST API Access Policies are enforced for a given key (affects which tables are reachable)
Whether request bodies are stored in the transaction log
